title: Crop register
sub: Every crop on the registered farms, added up per district and governorate, with an estimated harvest. Below, the list of crops farmers can pick in the app.
report_sub: Pick a crop and an area. The report opens in a new tab, ready to print or save as PDF.
report_note: The report counts only farms registered in Jutyar. It is not a census.
map_all: Registered dunam per district, all crops
none_here: No farm grows this crop yet.
harvest_note: Expected harvest = registered dunam times the typical yield in the crop list. Weather, water and disease change the real harvest; change the typical yield in the crop list when you have better numbers.
code_hint: small English letters, used by the app and the database
code_fixed: cannot change after it is made
in_app_q: Farmers can pick it in the app
delete_text: No farm uses this crop, so it can be deleted. This cannot be undone.
in_use_text: Some farms grow this crop, so it cannot be deleted without losing their data. Switch it off instead: farmers stop seeing it in the app and the farms keep their records.
v_code: Use 2 to 24 small English letters or _ (for example sugar_beet).
v_code_taken: A crop already has this code.
group_hint: Only products in the group Crops can be put on a farm.
unit_hint: What a listing in the Alwa market is counted and priced in.
products_live: Checked against the server's product list ({n} products): missing products, groups and units were filled in from it. Changes made here are kept in this browser only.
products_sample: The server's product list could not be read, so this is the built-in list.
